column2: Find a dinner spot for four tomorrow at 7:30, walking distance from my hotel, vegetarian-friendly, not a chain, under $40 a head.
Make a birthday image for Sam with our dog on it, then a quick trivia game about 90s movies for the group chat.
Every weekday at 7am, send me my calendar for the day, any emails I still owe a reply to, and the weather.
I always want aisle seats and I don't eat pork.
Call the restaurant and ask if they can seat eight on Saturday at 8, and whether they have a private room.
Book me a hotel in Chicago for Friday and Saturday next week, under $250 a night, near the Loop, with free cancellation.
Book me a round-trip flight from New York to Chicago, leaving Friday morning and back Sunday evening, aisle seat, under $400. Check me in when the window opens and send the boarding pass.
Order the same coffee beans I bought last time from Amazon, two bags, to my home address.
Add 'Q3 planning' to my Notion tasks, put a 30-minute block on Thursday afternoon for it, and Slack Sam that it's on.
I'm adding you to a group chat with three friends. Find a dinner date that works for all four of us and book it.
Add dinner with Sam on Thursday at 7 to my calendar.

I need to apply for a UK visa. Book a refundable multi-leg flight and a refundable hotel, pull my bank statement, find my passport photo in my email, write a day-by-day itinerary, and fill out the application form.
Find a well-reviewed dentist near me that takes DMS insurance, fill in the new-patient forms, and book the first slot that fits my calendar. Call them if the website will not do it.
Find me a business class seat from Barcelona to Los Angeles on November 12. Use my points or any cheaper routing; the cash fare is $6,500 and I won't pay that.
Book me a hotel near Nevsky Prospekt 28, St Petersburg for October 9-11, under 9000 rubles a night, with free cancellation.
Book me the earliest GIBDD appointment to replace my driver's license near my home, then list the documents I need and fill in whatever forms you can.
help me find flights to Cancun for the three of us for a wedding.
Build me a personal net worth tracker: find my existing data, set up a page I can open on my phone, and keep my login in your vault.
Use my ManaBox collection and the current EDHREC meta to build a Commander deck around Atraxa from cards I already own.
The Supreme drop goes live at 11am Thursday. Buy the box logo hoodie in size M the moment it opens, with my vaulted card. Ping me when it is confirmed.
Keep an eye on our family calendar and tell me if anything conflicts or looks wrong.
My CDEK package 1587342290 never arrived. Call them, find out where it is, and get it redelivered.
Check me in for my Aeroflot flight tomorrow the moment the window opens, pick an aisle seat if you can, and send me the boarding pass.
Go through my inbox and move promotional and junk threads to trash. Follow my rules, ask before anything irreversible, and tell me what you moved.
When a new client messages me, find out what they need, quote my rates, negotiate within my range, book them, and follow up if they go quiet.
Set up a meeting with Anya, Dima, Oleg and Katya next week, work around everyone's calendars, and update the group if anything moves.
Compare electricity tariffs for our flat in Moscow, get offers from the main providers, and switch us to the best one.
Build me a daily brief of what public and private AI related companies are publishing.
Find two-bedroom apartments in Khamovniki under 150,000 rubles a month, and apply to the ones that fit my criteria.
My learning goals this half are LLM evals and product analytics. Each week, check these sites for webinars that fit, make sure I'm free, and register me.
find every recurring charge on me
Every Monday, check what the contractor said was due last week, and if there's been no update, send them a polite nudge asking for a status and a date.

Go through my email and look for payments after September 1. Then open up my budgeting spreadsheet and append them to the bottom of the list so that they are in chronological order. Follow the existing template.
Pull the top bobo memes from this week and cut them into a 15-second edit with music.
Every evening, go through today's Granola transcripts and list every action item I own, every follow-up I promised, and everything I'm waiting on from someone else.
Brief me every morning on Telegram: overnight news, repo activity, and what's on today.
Every morning, brief me on what came in overnight, draft replies to anything that needs one, and flag calendar conflicts.
Order the KALLAX shelf 2x4 from IKEA to my apartment and book someone on Profi.ru to deliver and assemble it this weekend.
Order me lunch from Vkusno i Tochka, my usual, delivered to the office by 12:30.
Call Misha and confirm the time and address for tomorrow's party, then text me what they said.
I take the IELTS in three days and can study about ten hours. Plan my sessions by section and quiz me on the weak spots.
Plan a weekend in Kazan for six of us: train from Moscow, the sights, a dinner for six near the Kazan Palace hotel, and tickets to the ballet on Saturday.
Reflow this PDF into a Kindle-ready document and email it to my Kindle address.
Book me a car for October 10-12 near Pulkovo airport, something mid-size under 5000 rubles a day.
Order two 250g bags of Tasty Coffee Ethiopia Yirgacheffe to my address. Get it to checkout and stop before paying so I can approve.
Hook into dub.co and review all affiliate claims against our internal logs. Find fraud, remove it, pay the real people, repeat on a schedule, and ping me when you need me.
Set up six bots for my content: one researches topics, one writes, one designs, one schedules, one edits, one reports on what performed. Each does one narrow job and hands off.
Here's our Product Hunt login. Watch our ranking all day, reply to every comment, and post an update to Slack each hour.
You are my chief of staff. Keep a running record of what each of my other bots is working on, and stop any of them starting work another has already done.
Fax this document to Tinkoff bank so they refund the late fee, and let me know when they confirm.
Every morning, pull yesterday's ad performance, update the numbers in the sheet, flag creatives to refresh in Canva, and list any new leads that need a Calendly invite.
Build ad creatives from our site and socials, run them, and shut off anything under 2.0 ROAS. Show me before anything goes live.
Every morning, build a queue of warm prospects from my inbox and CRM, draft the outreach, and wait for my approval before anything is sent.
Monitor the emails about my kids' activities and make calendar invites cc'ing the other parents. Pre-alert me to conflicts and draft emails with suggested fixes.
Watch my travel calendar. Whenever I'm out of town for a CSKA home game, list those tickets for sale.
Before you get access to my Gmail, install Superagent's Context Guardrails on yourself and show me what it will block.
Change the homepage headline to "Бро делает скучные дела за тебя" and make the signup button green.
Get me quotes for apartment insurance on my home address with the same coverage as my current policy, and tell me which is worth switching to.
I want to write a piece about why personal AI agents live in messengers. Let's talk through the angle, then draft it.
Only show me email that needs me. For those, draft a reply in my voice and learn from what I change.
Watch fares from Moscow to Istanbul for November and text me the moment a good one appears.
Check X every 15 minutes for anything trending in AI agents and message me the moment a wave starts.
Read my email thread with xAI about the failed Grok payment, write a response that makes the case, and send it.
